name: io.github.stophydotdev/mcp
title: Stophy
description: Search, read, and act on the web. The Stophy MCP server for agents.

tools.name: stophy_scrape
tools.description: Scrape any public web page as markdown, HTML, links, a screenshot or JSON. For fields from any page, send formats [{"type":"json","prompt":"..."}] or a schema; this needs an API key. For a site's own data, send its page URL with formats [{"type":"json","parser":"<name>"}] and the parser's inputs, such as page, in options. Some sites can only be read this way. Parsers: google: maps, maps-place, maps-reviews, trends, patents, ads, flights, hotels, play-app, play-search, play-reviews; upwork: search, job; craigslist: search, listing; careers: jobs, job; indeed: search, job; realtor: search, property; zillow: search, property; expedia: hotels; booking: search, hotel, reviews; airbnb: search, listing, reviews; youtube: search, video, transcript, comments, channel, post, playlist; reddit: search, post, subreddit, user, subreddits; instagram: post, profile, comments, transcript, feed; x: profile, community, post; threads: profile, post; pinterest: search, pin, board, profile; facebook: page, group, post, comments, marketplace; tiktok: video, comments, transcript, profile, hashtag, sound, search, ads, shop, followers, following, trending, live; linkedin: jobs, job, company, profile, posts, ads; meta: ads; amazon: product, reviews, search, bestsellers; ebay: search, item; appstore: app, reviews, search, top; trustpilot: company, reviews, search; yelp: business, reviews, search; tripadvisor: search, place, reviews; glassdoor: company, reviews, salaries; crunchbase: company; g2: reviews; luma: events, event; emails; phone: numbers; bsky: profile, post; link: in-bio; twitch: profile, clips; faa: airport-status; airport: security-waits; flightstats: flight, airport, airport-delays. Also takes onlyCleanContent, minAge, headers, skipTlsVerification, removeBase64Images, imageUrls, allMetaTags, blockAds, fastMode, storeInCache, lockdown, checkPromptInjection, redactPII, profile, zeroDataRetention. Free without a key, within limits; with a key, $1 per 1,000 pages; JSON, summaries and PDF text cost more, and a parser has its own price.

url.description: The page or PDF to read.

anyOf.description: Objects with a type: changeTracking (modes, schema, prompt, tag), question (question), product, menu, screenshot (fullPage, quality, viewport), highlights (query, count), json (parser, options, schema, prompt, rules, checkPromptInjection), attributes (selectors).

formats.description: What to return: names, or objects with a type. Default markdown.

onlyMainContent.description: Default true: leaves out menus, headers and footers.

includeTags.description: CSS selectors to keep, such as article.

excludeTags.description: CSS selectors to drop, such as .comments.

maxAge.description: Oldest stored answer to accept, in ms. 0 reads live.

waitFor.description: Extra ms to wait before reading, up to 60000.

mobile.description: Read the page as a phone.

timeout.description: How long to keep trying, in ms.

items.description: Objects with a type: wait (milliseconds, selector), click (selector, all), write (text), press (key), scroll (direction, amount, maxScrolls, selector), screenshot (fullPage, quality, viewport), scrape, executeJavascript (script), pdf (format, landscape, scale), perform (action).

actions.description: Steps to run on the page before reading it, in order.

location.description: { country, languages } to read from. Default US.

proxy.description: auto tries basic, then enhanced if refused. Same price.

linkStyle.description: none (default here) keeps link text only; inline keeps [text](address); numbered lists addresses at the end.

maxChars.description: Cut the markdown at this many characters; nextOffset says where to read on.

offset.description: Start this many characters in; send the last nextOffset.

query.description: What you look for; a long page comes back as the matching passages.

tools.name: stophy_search
tools.description: Search the web, news, images, scholarly papers and YouTube videos in one call. Also takes maxAge, country, lang, safe, timeout, ignoreInvalidURLs. Free without a key, within limits; with a key, $0.001 per 10 results from each source; pages it reads cost as in stophy_scrape.

query.description: What to search for. Operators such as site:, -word and quotes work.

anyOf.description: Objects with a type: web (tbs, location, country, lang).

scrapeLimit.description: Read only the top this many results.

tbs.description: Time filter: qdr:d, qdr:w, qdr:m or qdr:y. sbd:1 sorts newest first.

location.description: Where to search from, such as Germany.

highlights.description: true makes description the passages that match the query, where we can.

zeroDataRetention.description: true skips saved copies. Some asynchronous features keep temporary state.

scrapeOptions.description: stophy_scrape options for each page, such as formats. With formats, each result's page is read.

tools.name: stophy_map
tools.description: Scrape the list of pages on a website. Also takes ignoreQueryParameters, deduplicateSimilarURLs, ignoreCache, timeout, location. Free without a key, within limits; with a key, $0.50 per 1,000 calls.

search.description: Keep addresses that mention these words, best first.

sitemap.description: include (default) uses sitemaps and links, only uses sitemaps, skip links.

zeroDataRetention.description: true skips saved copies. Some asynchronous features keep temporary state.

tools.name: stophy_parse
tools.description: Turn a PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint or HTML file, or a picture of text, into markdown. Also takes onlyMainContent, includeTags, excludeTags, removeBase64Images, zeroDataRetention. Free without a key, within limits; with a key, $0.50 per 1,000 pages with a text layer, $2.50 per 1,000 pages read from a picture.

anyOf.description: Objects with a type: json (prompt, schema).

formats.description: Besides markdown: summary, html, rawHtml, links, images, or { type: json, schema or prompt }.

file.description: The file as base64, up to 36 MB: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML or a picture.

maxPages.description: Most PDF pages, sheets or slides to read.

tools.name: stophy_signup
tools.description: Needs no key. Returns a claimUrl for your person to approve and a secret code. Call it again with the code to collect the key once they approve. Returns at once, so call again later.

code.description: The code from an earlier signup. Send it to collect the key once approved.
